operators.name: adaptive_avg_pool1d

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: [batch, input_channels, input_length] (any dimensions where input_length >= output_length)

semantics: Performs adaptive average pooling over the last dimension: for each output position i, computes the average of input values in the bin [floor(i * L_in / L_out), ceil((i+1) * L_in / L_out)).
Preserves batch and channel dimensions; output size along last dimension is output_size.
Input is expected on CUDA; if input is not contiguous, operator should handle strides or ensure contiguity internally.
No bias or other parameters involved.

operators.name: repeat_interleave_like

returns.shape: [batch, repeats, channels, length] (if dim=1, output shape matches torch.stack([input]*repeats, dim=1))

semantics: Replicates the input tensor `repeats` times along a new dimension `dim`, exactly equivalent to torch.stack([input] * repeats, dim=dim).
The output shares the same data as input but with an added dimension; no computation beyond copying data.
If dim is negative, it is normalized as dim + input.dim() + 1 (consistent with torch.stack semantics).
Output is contiguous; if input is not contiguous, data is copied into contiguous output.
The operator must handle any rank >= 1.
Calls nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(output_size=64) on input tensor of shape [64, 1024, 4096] float32.
Output tensor shape [64, 1024, 64], dtype float32, device cuda.
Each output element is the average of input values in the corresponding adaptive bin.
Creates a new tensor by stacking `pool_size` copies of `x` along dimension 1.
Output shape [64, 16, 1024, 64], dtype float32, device cuda.
Elements are identical to `x` at corresponding indices.
Returns the final tensor from step_002.
